items.searchText: oof-aii-835662 chatgpt-4o allegedly discouraged florida pastor from seeking care before pulmonary embolism florida pastor scott winters was allegedly told by chatgpt-4o that his worsening dizziness and pain had less serious causes, while the chatbot recommended home management and immobility and discouraged him from seeking hospital treatment. winters was reportedly hospitalized on july 13, 2025, with a massive bilateral pulmonary embolism. the suit alleges that delayed treatment and prolonged inactivity contributed to his life-threatening condition and lasting harms. united states of america chatgpt, gpt 4o, chatbots, large language models clia® — cognitive governance intelligence architecture
